**Batch 45 authoring is complete:** 10 A items, 5 examples, both pages, manifests, contracts, source coverage, dependency evidence, notes, and Step 1 records are in place.

Eight items are `ready`. Seven—the lattice theorem and its periodic, Fermi, Bose-condensation consumers and examples—are `escalated` because the CSM supplier’s planned M17 production carrier is absent. Their conditional proofs are complete, and the missing interface is recorded.

Scoped checks passed: proof layout (14 items, 60 steps), precheck (15, 0 failures), proof contracts (15/15), rendering, content policy, focused dependency checking, and source coverage. All five source documents passed fetch verification: [Tong’s lecture notes](https://davidtong.org/pdfs/teaching/statistical-physics/statphys.pdf) and [MIT OCW Lectures 22–25](https://live.ocw.mit.edu/courses/8-333-statistical-mechanics-i-statistical-mechanics-of-particles-fall-2013/).

The batch 45 item levels match their manifests. The full-run item-level check reports 139 errors outside this batch. The run-wide batch schedule is stale due to unrelated dependency changes in batches 22 and 59; batch 45’s recorded level and requirement still match. I left that shared schedule for the owner.
